business_problem: Iké is an assistance services company that faced the challenge of upgrading its server infrastructure.
solution_summary: Iké used Azure AI Services, Power Platform, Azure Databricks to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. It also connects with surrounding systems such as WhatsApp, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Iké improved data availability and security with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks and Azure AI Services.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale data and runs analytical or machine-learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs integrated SQL and big-data analytics across enterprise datasets.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Lake Storage
solution_components.role: Stores raw and curated data for analytics, AI, and downstream reporting.

data_flow: Data flows from operational systems through source-system connectors into Azure Data Lake Storage, where Azure Databricks prepares and enriches it; business applications then exposes governed analytics and decision support to end users.
